In Person Interview will be scheduled in Dearborn office address mentioned above on December 3rd. In-person interview is mandatory (Expenses will be borne by the client) 
   Role: Mainframe Developer 
   No. of positions: 30

 Strong mainframe skills including COBOL, DB2, IMS, MVS, JCL, CA7, TSO/SPF, IBM AD Tools. Knowledge and experience with Endeavor , DB2/SQL, FTP, Connect Direct, DB2 Connect, and Stored Procedures. Exceptional analytical experience of complex applications and data relationships

 Desired Skills: Experience working on Banking domain   



 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS
